text:
morgan: Quick heads-up - during the weekly least-priv sweep I found a KMS grant on a prod key that isn't in our current service inventory. Posting here to triage before the rotation window. Key: 8352f9a2-cc4b-4f9e-9a12-6a8c2b7d9f3e (prod/us-west). Grant ID: grant-0a1b2c3d. :eyes:

devon: Can you paste the grant details and the principal?

morgan: Sure - grabbed from the KMS list-grants API:
{
  "GrantId": "grant-0a1b2c3d",
  "GranteePrincipal": "arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/analytics-service",
  "IssuingAccountId": "999999999999",
  "Operations": ["Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey"],
  "CreationDate": "2026-03-19T14:22:08Z"
}

priya: That role (analytics-service) was decommissioned in Q4 last year per inventory-service. No active owners. I'll run a narrow CloudTrail query for grant creation and any subsequent uses.

sam: If CloudTrail shows no recent usage, we can plan a surgical removal during low traffic. Want to confirm no live jobs reference that key. Can we grep logs for the key ID?

priya: Running quick CloudTrail and app log scans now. Found a CreateGrant event at 2026-03-19T14:22:08Z by iam-principal user:deploy-bot@infra-team. No Encrypt/Decrypt events referencing the key in the last 90 days. Snippet:
2026-03-19T14:22:08Z CreateGrant GrantId=grant-0a1b2c3d Principal=arn:aws:sts::999999999999:assumed-role/deploy-bot/ci-run

oncall-bot: [ALERT] orphaned-kms-grant detected by entitlement-sweeper at 2026-03-20T03:00:12Z - severity: medium. See SEC-3421.

devon: Sounds like a stale grant created via CI when the service still existed. Two options: 1) remove the grant now, 2) attach a policy condition with NotPrincipal to effectively block. Given no traffic, removal is fine but we should create a canary rollback plan.

morgan: I prefer removal + monitoring. Opened ticket SEC-3421 in Security queue and linked the rotation window. Plan: Priya will remove the grant in 30m during the artifact-freeze window, Devon will add an audit filter to alert on any new grants to that key, Sam will monitor app error channels for 60 minutes after removal. I'll watch CloudTrail and SecretsManager access logs. :white_check_mark:

priya: Will perform removal with dry-run first. Command (AWS CLI):
aws kms retire-grant --grant-id grant-0a1b2c3d --key-id 8352f9a2-cc4b-4f9e-9a12-6a8c2b7d9f3e --profile prod

sam: I'll subscribe to the app-error pager and set a 1-hour handoff. If anything breaks, revert by re-creating a scoped temporary grant and paging infra.

devon: Also adding a CloudWatch metric filter for any Encrypt/Decrypt on that key and a CloudTrail lookup alert for new CreateGrant events targeting that key. Will push as config change to the security stack.

morgan: Thanks. One follow-up ask: can we add a weekly ownership lint that signals keys with grants whose principals aren't in inventory? That would've caught this earlier. Put that on SEC backlog (SEC-3422).

priya: Removal complete - CLI output:
Retired Grant: grant-0a1b2c3d on KeyId 8352f9a2-...
Status: OK

sam: Nothing on pager so far. App errors = 0 for 30m post-removal. Monitoring ongoing.

devon: Alert filter pushed to security stack and deployed to us-west prod (CFN change). Added CloudWatch alarm: KMSKeyUsage-8352f9a2.

morgan: Great - closing this quick-hit. Summary for the ticket: stale grant removed, no service impact observed, audit filters added, ownershp-lint requested (SEC-3422). Thanks everyone. :tada:
